verdict.rationale: Docs confirm real integrations with QuickBooks Online (export sync) and NetSuite (expense syncing/reporting/accounting), plus a 'multi-level GL coding' feature suggesting GL account/class/department mapping control, but there's no explicit mention of Xero or of finance-lead-controlled class/department field mapping specifically. Missing for 10: explicit Xero integration evidence, detailed documentation of user-controlled class/department mapping configuration, and independent/hands-on confirmation that mappings work as configured.
